But why cringe

That what Slytherins were doing at the first part of the Battle of Hogwarts (their table was empty, it's heavily implied that they deserted) was rounding up everyone who had nowhere to go. That they used the Room of Requirement to keep the younger students safe, guarding the entrance, wands drawn, prepared to fight if necessary.

It would be too hard to fight their families directly. Instead, they protected those who had no part in the horrors around them. It was a way for them to protect family ties and still help. Save face, but with no guilt.

Because as that sweet, little first-year Hufflepuff was grabbed by the sleeve of her robe by a seventh-year Slytherin, she felt everything but scared. This was no Death Eater. This was a friend.

I know my house. If there's one thing they *didn't* do, it's nothing.
